decision.summary: A correlated multi-axis deformation episode is observed from index 660 onward: E elevated, N rising, U dipping—consistent with slow surface motion. The onset is clear (~660), interior is sustained (~660–689), but the return is only partially evident in U and absent/unconfirmed in N/E within allowed context [620,729]. Thus, no confirmed temporary offset; one uncertain interval reported.

intervals.observation: E shows sustained elevation (~+2–3 MAD) from 660 to 689; N rises modestly and coherently over same interval; U dips (~−2 MAD) peaking ~675–685. Return in U begins near 690 but is incomplete/ambiguous in N/E; no clear opposing recovery observed in E or N before end of allowed context (729).
